introTr: Yedi haftadır çalışıyorsun ve artık iş başvurusu, geçmiş olaylar ve tavsiyeler hakkında konuşabiliyorsun. Bu deneme biraz daha zor; zorlandığın soru normal, onlar zaten öğreneceğin yerleri gösteriyor. Sakin sakin çöz.

items.q: I ___ in Turkey until 2022. Now I live in Ohio.
items.whyTr: Bitmiş bir dönem (until 2022) için past simple kullanılır.

items.q: She ___ in this school for six years, and she still loves it.
items.whyTr: Hâlâ devam eden süre için present perfect: has worked.

items.q: How long ___ in the United States?
items.whyTr: 'How long' ile devam eden durum sorusu: have you lived.

items.q: I ___ for an hour. I'm tired now.
items.whyTr: Süregelen eylem ve şu anki sonuç: present perfect continuous.

items.q: I ___ dinner when the phone rang.
items.whyTr: Yemek pişirme sürerken telefon çaldı: past continuous + past simple.

items.q: When the fire alarm ___, the students were reading quietly.
items.whyTr: Kısa, araya giren olay past simple; uzun olay past continuous.

items.q: In Isparta, we ___ walk to the market every Saturday.
items.whyTr: Geçmişteki alışkanlık için 'used to + fiil'.

items.q: By the time I arrived, the interview ___.
items.whyTr: Başka bir geçmiş olaydan önce olan: past perfect (had + V3).

items.q: She ___ the form before she gave it to Mr. Brown.
items.whyTr: Önce olan eylem past perfect: had signed.

items.q: I will call you as soon as I ___ to the school.
items.whyTr: As soon as ile gelecek zaman cümleciğinde geniş zaman kullanılır.

items.q: Take an umbrella. It ___ rain this afternoon.
items.whyTr: Olasılık için might + fiil yalın hali.

items.q: He is wearing a suit, so he ___ have an interview today.
items.whyTr: Güçlü çıkarım (büyük olasılıkla) için must kullanılır.

items.q: That ___ be Mr. Brown's car. He drives a red truck, and this car is blue.
items.whyTr: Neredeyse imkânsız olan çıkarım için can't kullanılır.

items.q: You ___ see a doctor. That cough sounds serious.
items.whyTr: Güçlü tavsiye: had better + fiil yalın hali.

items.q: You ___ arrive early for the interview. It makes a good impression.
items.whyTr: Tavsiye için should + fiil.

items.q: ___ it was raining, we walked to school.
items.whyTr: Cümle başında zıtlık bağlacı: Although + özne + fiil.

items.q: The test was difficult. ___, everyone passed.
items.whyTr: Ayrı cümleyi başlatan zıtlık sözü: However, ...

items.q: If I ___ a teacher, I would help every student.
items.whyTr: Gerçek dışı durumda: If + geçmiş zaman (were), would + fiil.

items.q: The woman ___ works at the front office is my friend.
items.whyTr: Kişiyi tanımlarken ilgi zamiri who kullanılır.

items.q: Emre ___ his homework when I came home.
items.whyTr: Eve gelince devam eden eylem: past continuous.

items.q: What is the opposite of 'hire'?
items.whyTr: Hire (işe almak) kelimesinin zıttı fire (işten çıkarmak).

items.q: 'She sent her application on Monday.' An application is:
options: a formal request for a job
items.whyTr: Application, iş başvurusudur.

items.q: 'She is qualified for the job.' Qualified means:
options: having the right skills or education
items.whyTr: Qualified, işe uygun nitelikte demektir.

items.q: 'Please attach your resume.' A resume is:
options: a document about your work and education
items.whyTr: Resume, iş ve eğitim geçmişini anlatan belgedir.

items.q: I want to apply ___ a job at the library.
items.whyTr: 'Apply for a job' sabit kalıptır.

items.q: What is the opposite of 'permanent'?
items.whyTr: Permanent (kalıcı) kelimesinin zıttı temporary (geçici).

items.q: 'The candidate was well prepared.' A candidate is:
options: a person who applies for a job
items.whyTr: Candidate, bir işe aday olan kişidir.

items.q: She can't ___ a decision yet.
items.whyTr: 'Make a decision' karar vermek demektir.

items.q: Which word means the same as 'huge'?
items.whyTr: Huge ve enormous: çok büyük.

items.q: 'The bus broke down, so I was late.' Broke down means:
items.whyTr: Break down, bozulmak, çalışmaz hale gelmek demektir.

items.q: 'My schedule is flexible.' Flexible means:
items.whyTr: Flexible, esnek ve kolay değişebilir demektir.

items.q: What is the opposite of 'strict'?
items.whyTr: Strict (katı) kelimesinin zıttı easygoing (rahat, hoşgörülü).

passages.title: Waiting for the call
passages.text:
Hafsa applied for a job at Lincoln Elementary two weeks ago. Before she applied, she had asked Mr. Brown many questions. By the time she sent her application, she had updated her resume and had asked Ms. Carter for a reference letter.

Since then, she has been waiting for a call. Every morning she checks her phone. Yesterday, it rang while she was cooking dinner. It was Mr. Brown. 'We would like to interview you on Thursday,' he said. Hafsa was so happy that she almost burned the rice!

questions.q: When did Hafsa apply for the job?
What had Hafsa done before she sent her application?
options: She had started working at the school.
She had updated her resume and asked for a reference letter.
questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'she had updated her resume and had asked Ms. Carter for a reference letter'.

questions.q: What was Hafsa doing when Mr. Brown called?
questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'it rang while she was cooking dinner'.

passages.title: A strange morning at school
passages.text:
One morning, Hafsa arrived at school at 7:30, but the front door was locked. That was strange, because Mr. Brown usually opens it at 7:00. She looked through the window and saw that the lights were on. 'Someone must be inside,' she thought.

She knocked, but nobody answered. Then she noticed a sign on the door: 'Closed today for staff training.' Hafsa remembered that she had not read the email from the day before.

Just then, a teacher came out of the building. 'You can't be here to volunteer today,' she said with a smile. 'The school is closed to students and volunteers. But since you're here, would you like some coffee?' Hafsa felt a little embarrassed, but she accepted.

questions.q: Why was the locked door strange?
options: Mr. Brown usually opens it at 7:00.
questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'Mr. Brown usually opens it at 7:00'.

questions.q: Why did Hafsa think someone was inside?
questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'saw that the lights were on'.
Kapıdaki not: 'Closed today for staff training.'

options: She had not read the email about the closing.
questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'she had not read the email from the day before'.

passages.title: A thank-you email
passages.text:
After her interview, Hafsa wrote an email to the principal, Dr. Lopez.

'Dear Dr. Lopez,

Thank you for meeting with me on Thursday. Although I am new to American schools, I am a fast learner and I am very motivated. I have been volunteering at Lincoln Elementary for six months, and I have learned how the front office, the library and the classrooms work. However, I know that I still have a lot to learn about the district's rules, so I would like to take the substitute training course as soon as possible.

I am available every day except Friday. If you need any other documents, please let me know.

Sincerely,
Hafsa'

questions.q: Why did Hafsa write the email?
options: To ask for a day off
To thank the principal for the interview
questions.whyTr: Email 'Thank you for meeting with me' diye başlıyor.

questions.q: What has Hafsa been doing for six months?
questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'I have been volunteering at Lincoln Elementary for six months'.

questions.q: On which day is Hafsa NOT available?

Her ID and two reference letters

script.text: Linda, I can't find Emre's backpack anywhere.

She saw him at the door.

questions.whyTr: Linda: 'practice might be canceled ... It's raining hard.'
Hafsa: 'I will check my text messages.'

script.text: Are you ready for your interview on Thursday?

Linda: 'you shouldn't wear too much perfume'.

writing.promptTr: Okul müdürü Dr. Lopez'e bir e-posta yaz. Substitute teacher olmak için başvurmak istiyorsun. Kendini tanıt, ne zamandır ABD'de yaşadığını ve hangi deneyimlerin olduğunu anlat. Kısa bir soru da sor.
writing.promptEn: Write an email to Dr. Lopez, the school principal. Say you would like to apply to be a substitute teacher. Tell her how long you have lived in the US and what experience you have. Ask one question.
checklistTr: Selamlama ve kapanış yazdım mı (Dear ... / Sincerely)?
'I have lived ... for / since ...' cümlesini doğru kurdum mu?
Geçmişteki deneyimi past simple ile anlattım mı (I taught...)?
Kibar bir soru veya rica yazdım mı (Could you tell me ...?)?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve nokta ile bitiyor mu?
writing.model:
Dear Dr. Lopez,

My name is Hafsa, and I would like to apply to be a substitute teacher. I have lived in Ohio for four years. In Turkey, I taught English to children for two years, and I have been volunteering at Lincoln Elementary since last spring. Although I am new to the American school system, I learn quickly and I am very patient. I am available every day except Fridays. Could you tell me what documents I need to bring?

Thank you for your time.

Sincerely,
Hafsa
